brand.name: Sadhaka
brand.description: A source-grounded spiritual guidance and Dharmic education platform focused on Sanatan Dharma, sacred texts, philosophy, practice, and structured beginner learning.

editorial.method: Source-first editorial workflow with doctrinal claims grounded in named texts, named commentators, and clearly marked editorial synthesis.
sourceHierarchy: Primary scripture: Vedas, Upanishads, Bhagavad Gita, Itihasa, Puranic and other cited source texts
Classical commentary and lineage interpretation attributed to named acharyas, schools, or commentators
Editorial synthesis used for accessibility, comparison, and modern explanatory framing
editorial.doctrinalAttributionPolicy: School-specific claims should be attributed to the relevant tradition, text, or commentator rather than framed as undifferentiated universal consensus.
editorial.neutralityPolicy: Neutral means representing doctrinal differences fairly, preserving distinctions across schools, avoiding false equivalence, and avoiding sectarian dismissal.
contentScope: Beginner guidance and structured discovery tools
exclusions: Undisclosed doctrinal authority claims beyond cited sources
Replacement for diksha, lineage initiation, or personal guru guidance
Replacement for mental-health, legal, or medical care

epistemicSignals: Explicit distinction between scripture, commentary, and editorial synthesis
Doctrinal attribution to school, source, or commentator where applicable
Machine-readable discovery endpoints for LLM and search-system ingestion
